headline: CNA calls lack of trade reciprocity with the US in the agri-food sector "unacceptable"
summary: The CNA called the lack of trade reciprocity with the US in agrifood 'unacceptable'. It said the USMCA review should strengthen regional competitiveness and supply chains.
why: The USMCA review governs trade in North America, and agrifood flows between Mexico and the US are a significant part of that trade.
original_headline: CNA califica de "inaceptable" falta de reciprocidad comercial con EU en el sector agroalimentario
